name: Cobe
summary: 5KB WebGL globe library that renders an interactive globe with markers and arcs on a canvas.
description: A ~5KB zero-dependency WebGL globe you draw onto a canvas via createGlobe(canvas, options), which returns update() and destroy() methods. Options cover size, rotation, land darkness and more; markers and arcs connect locations and can be bound to DOM elements through CSS anchor names and visibility variables. Works with React, Vue, Svelte or vanilla JS.
contains: createGlobe(canvas, options) returns update() and destroy() methods
options incl. width, height, phi, theta and dark for rotation and land darkness
markers and arcs bound to DOM elements via CSS anchor names and visibility variables
works with React, Vue, Svelte or vanilla JS
